anchors.description: Queen-size bed width across the head end, where the left and right mattress/comforter edges meet the line of the two flanking nightstands

anchors.identity_uncertainty: Queen (1.53 m) vs full (1.37 m) vs king (1.93 m); two standard pillows filling most of the width favor queen, and comforter overhang adds roughly 5-10 cm.
